dialog: I'll pounce/ then scratch you out!
Miss Ran and Miss Yukari are probably watching...
I'll keep going until I need a cat-nap!
Bet you can't follow these moves!
I'm gonna show off my cool side!
Miss Ran/ I can help too!
I can be good enough! I think!
I'm a full-grown youjuu/ watch out!
You can't just be a scaredy-cat all the time!
I gotta show them how amazing Miss Ran's shiki can be!
I'll show you that I can keep up!
I'm Miss Ran's shiki... I can do this!
This might be my last life...
I can still fight... gotta keep going!
I'll put some youkai power in it!
If you're a real bakeneko/ you gotta be able to do this!
Everyone/ let's all pounce at once!
Even if you're a runt or a kid/ you gotta keep up!
Chen/ do just as I say/ okay?
With our simultaneous attacks/ we cannot miss!
Hmm. I suppose the shiki was a little weak...
If I had some help from Miss Ran...
Chen/ do it exactly like we practiced.
You need to match my timing perfectly.
I'll get some help from Miss Ran!
Okay/ Chen/ this time we'll have you take the lead.
Um/ Miss Ran/ I'm not so sure I should-
If all you have to do is dodge/ it's real simple!
I'll get you for this later.
Attacking from that far away is unfair!
You- you won't get away with this!
Miss Ran always says to listen to your partner's orders/ so...
Got it/ you can count on me!
I've gotta show them what I can do!
I won't get in your way!
You can leave it to me!
Make sure not to hit me!
I'll show you how much I can try!
If we're gonna race/ don't worry/ I'll win!
I'm Miss Ran's shiki... I can do this!
Miss Yuyuko/ I'm doing my best too!
I'll try really hard/ Miss Yuyuko!
Okay! Leave it up to me!
Miss Yuyuko/ I'll fight with you!
You can leave the running parts up to me!
When I'm with Miss Yuyuko/ no one can beat us!
I'll show Miss Yuyuko how much I'm trying!
I can't give up/ for Miss Ran's sake...
Miss Ran/ I'll help out too!
Miss Ran/ I can help too!
I'll give it a try/ Miss Ran!
When I'm with Miss Ran/ no one can beat us!
I hope I don't mess up in front of Miss Ran...
Miss Ran/ I'll fight with you!
Miss Ran/ that one's our next target/ right?
I'll show Miss Ran how much I'm trying!
When I'm with Miss Ran/ no one can beat us!
I can't give up/ for Miss Yukari's sake...
Miss Yukari/ I'm doing my best too!
Miss Yukari/ that one's our next target/ right?
You can leave the running parts up to me!
I'll do my best/ Miss Yukari!
I'll show Miss Yukari how much I'm trying!
When I'm with Miss Yukari/ no one can beat us!
If it's a race/ I'll always win!
Stay Vigilant/ just like Miss Ran says!
If I believe in myself/ I can do it!
I'm proud of my agility/ you know!
You can't get me that easily!
Miss Ran/ they don't seem that tough at all!
If this keeps happening I might lose...
Miss Ran/ what should I do?!
I might be in serious trouble...
Hey/ c- calm down a little...
H- how'd things get like this?!
They figured out where I was going?!
I was ready for it and it STILL hurt...
I- I knew stuff like this might happen!
I can see right through that attack!
You left plenty of room to dodge through there!
A cat has a sixth sense for attacks like that!
You can't lure me into that!
Wonder if they weren't aiming at me...
You've just gotta believe in yourself...!
Looks like you can't keep up with me!
You can do it/ just try. \n It's just like Miss Ran said!
With this thing/\n I'll be fine no matter what!
If it's about nimbleness/ I'm second to none!
Miss Ran/ If we're fighting I'm allowed to hit them first/ right?
Waaah/ even though I really really tried...
Miss Ran/ Miss Yukari/ watch this!
The real sun is nicer to nap in than this!
Don't get in the way of the festival!
You're so full of energy/\n but you're using it to do bad things?
For Miss Ran and Miss Yukari!
You're the one who's been bothering Miss Yukari!
You're not supposed to do bad things!
I won't let some fake beat me!
Cats don't usually get to catch sheep!
Please stop!\n If you keep going like this/ you'll...
Even against Makura/\n together/ Ran and I can face her!
Against Makura/\n I've just got to run around even faster!
If I fight like mad/ I bet I can beat even Makura!
Even against you/ as long as I get to be with Miss Ran...
Against Shitone/ I've just got to run around even faster!
If I fight like mad/ I bet I can beat even Shitone!
I'll try really hard/ Miss Ran!
Against Miss Ran/\n I've really got to do my bestest!
I'll try really hard/ Miss Yuyuko!
Against Miss Yuyuko/\n I've really got to my bestest!
